memory: I confirm biexponential adsorption and pooled Arrhenius Ea ≈65 kJ·mol⁻¹. At −2.00°C with 300 s purge and anchored JFET, D2O τ_fast excesses were: 0.100 mm = 556 ±76 s; 0.050 mm = 347 ±62 s; 0.025 mm = 168 ±52 s. Excess decreases with gap approximately linearly between 0.025–0.100 mm, but transport‑limited curvature remains plausible due to large uncertainties and single runs per gap. Next action: run at 0.0375 ±0.003 mm with identical protocol, add replicates and blank checks, and optionally vary purge to test for transport limitation.
